input.summary: Add Licensee convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and bar Licensor convenience termination during the term.
input.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month term gives us no exit right, so we have added a Licensee right to terminate this Agreement for convenience on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Licensor has no convenience termination right during the term. If helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.text: Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund pro rata any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any renewal or extension term.
